notes.title: Save system update
notes.notes: We apologize for the inconvenience and bugs. The game now has a fixed save system. Enjoy the game! Old saves should work too!

notes.title: Update "Magic Stone"
notes.notes:
-- New: A magic stone has been added, which can very rarely appear in the dungeon. If it is destroyed, all the blocks along the x and y axes from this block will collapse. This will make your task much easier!
-- Updated main menu
-- Correction of the balance
-- Updated resource schedule
-- Character animation changes
-- Corrections of translations
-- The game has been transferred to a new version of the game engine

notes.title: Chinese localisation!
notes.notes: A Chinese translation (simplified) has been added to the game

notes.title: Dungeon Minesweeper Fix#1
notes.notes:
[u][b]Most of the bugs have been fixed![/b][/u]

[b]DM LOG FIX#1[/b]

--Fixed Russian localisation.
--Fixed background in menu for rare display resolutions.
--Fixed language changing if loading a save.
--Fixed creation of different objects in 1 cell.
--Reducing the lifetime of particles during the destruction of the stone.
--There is no longer an icon for the "increase the viewing radius" effect in the normal minesweeper mode.
--It is no longer possible to move while the menu is open.
--Fixed a bug that made it possible to dig blocks and attack enemies while you are in the main menu.
--Fixed shop text on small resolutions
--Shop is now available in any time
--Fixed bugs with downloading hardcore saves.
--The achievement for the boss in hardcore mode has been fixed.
--Fixed saving in hardcore mode.
--Now there will be no enemies in the starting location. You will survive!

[u]Many thanks to the user sdumitriu for the help in finding bugs![/u]

notes.title: What is our game about?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740309/67e634e42f56adf0b04520b7a7b761781a7390d8.jpg[/img]
[h2][b][u]What???[/u][/b][/h2]

The game development industry is poorly developed. We are all tired of classic games that repeat each other over and over again, down to the smallest detail. 

[b][h2]Genius idea[/h2][/b]
We decided to take a rather serious step - to cross a minesweeper and a roguelike. This is a unique game! You play as a character who miraculously ended up in a dungeon and has to get out of here. 

We are waiting for you to generate a dungeon, a plot, factions, many spells and perks, enemies and of course ore mining!

Follow the news!
